/* Texas v. Pennsylvania */  The citation tag here has been pending a year. I haven't resources to locate one to fulfill this WP:VERIFY requirement. **Sentence is therefore hidden until source is provided.** NOTE, per WP:VERIFY, it is responsibility of editor returning text to article/view, to include citation when returning it. Finally, NOTE, the two primary sources appearing are INsufficient support for the sentence—they are simply roll call data without clear mention of what votes were about.

The last edit hid two bare URL primary source citations, which need to be fully presented — not violate bare URL and incomplete citation guidelines — when that sentence is returned. As well, the citations styles here have begun to drift, from using the citation templates to (more recent) tacking on of bare URL's to the end of the citation, without doing a full edit to original pattern using citation templates. Will return after work to begin this cleanup; meanwhile, placing cleanup tag.
